raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a donut chart displaying two main categories: "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters," represented by a central blue circle and an outer ring, respectively. The "Virtual Characters" category, shown in blue, is subdivided into six segments labeled "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," "Game Characters," and an unlabeled segment adjacent to "Game Characters." These segments are all colored in varying shades of light blue and appear to be of similar size, suggesting roughly equal proportions. The "Real Characters" category, shown in green, is subdivided into seven segments labeled "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," each in a distinct shade of green. The segments in the "Real Characters" ring are also visually similar in size. The chart includes labels for each segment positioned outside the ring, with no percentages or numerical values displayed. There is no legend, and no segment is visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or highlighted). The segments in both rings appear to be arranged in a clockwise order without any apparent sorting by size.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This is a donut chart illustrating the categorization of characters into two main groups: "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters," with a central blue circle representing "Virtual Characters" and the surrounding ring divided into subcategories. The "Virtual Characters" category includes seven slices: "Comic Characters" (light blue), "Movie Characters" (light blue), "Teleplay Characters" (light blue), "Novel Characters" (light blue), "Game Characters" (light blue), and two additional light blue slices that are unlabeled but visually consistent with the others. The "Real Characters" category is represented by a green segment and further subdivided into six smaller slices: "Scientists" (light green), "Artists" (light green), "Athletes" (light green), "Writers" (light green), "Musicians" (light green), "Actors" (light green), and "Influencers" (light green). A small pink slice labeled "Custom Characters" is positioned between "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters," suggesting a separate or hybrid category. The chart does not display percentage values within the slices, nor does it include a legend. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with "Virtual Characters" occupying the majority of the outer ring, visually dominating the chart. The colors are distinct between the main categories—blue for virtual, green for real, and pink for custom—but subcategories within each group share similar shades.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm ist ein konzentrisches Kreisdiagramm, das die Kategorien "Virtual Characters" und "Real Characters" darstellt, wobei "Virtual Characters" den größeren, blauen inneren Kreis bildet und "Real Characters" einen grünen, kleineren Sektor im äußeren Ring einnimmt. Der äußere Ring ist in mehrere Segmente unterteilt, die jeweils eine Untergruppe repräsentieren. Die Segmente für "Virtual Characters" sind in verschiedenen Blautönen gehalten und umfassen "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters" sowie einen zentralen blauen Bereich mit der Beschriftung "Virtual Characters". Die Segmente für "Real Characters" sind in verschiedenen Grüntönen gehalten und umfassen "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors" und "Influencers". Ein weiteres Segment, "Custom Characters", ist in Rosa gehalten und grenzt an den blauen und grünen Bereich. Die Segmente sind im äußeren Ring in einer ungefähr absteigenden Reihenfolge nach Größe angeordnet, beginnend mit "Comic Characters" (größtes Segment) und endend mit "Influencers" (kleinstes Segment). Es gibt keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente, und keine Legende ist explizit angegeben. Die Beschriftungen sind direkt an die Segmente angebracht.
